reproduction_manifest.notes: Successfully reproduced C4 Perplexity for LLaMA-2 7B with EntQuant Float8 3-bit compression. Paper reports 7.55; our reproduction achieved 7.5491, an exact match within 0.001. Used Float8 (qfloat8_e4m3fn) quantization with reg_param=14.5, lr=1.0, and no super weight handling (spike_threshold=inf). C4 validation data was downloaded manually due to datasets library 4.4.1 incompatibility with HF mirror HEAD redirects.
reproduction_manifest.eval_output_format: Parse stdout for 'C4 Perplexity: <float>' line after script completes
known_levers: reg_param: controls entropy compression rate (14.5 for 3-bit, 58.0 for 2-bit, 3.9 for 4-bit)
lr: optimizer learning rate (1.0 for 3/4-bit, 0.25 for 2-bit)
weight_qtype: qfloat8 (default, Float8) or qint8 (Int8) base format
spike_threshold: super weight handling (inf = off, 50.0 = on for Float8)
ctx_length: context length for perplexity evaluation (2048 for LLaMA-2)
reproduction_manifest.setup_notes: Container built from fallback image docker.1ms.run/pytorch/pytorch:2.1.0-cuda12.1-cudnn8-runtime. Upgraded Python to 3.11 via conda (env py311). Installed gcc-10, build-essential, wget, cuda-nvcc, cuda-cudart-dev, libcusparse-dev, libcusolver-dev, libcublas-dev via apt/conda. Dependencies installed with uv sync using the repo's pyproject.toml (torch 2.9.1, transformers 4.57.3, optimum-quanto 0.2.7). Patched torch/include/ATen/core/List_inl.h to fix GCC 10 brace-initialization issue. Set CUDA_HOME=/opt/conda/envs/py311 and CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH to targets/x86_64-linux/include for CUDA header resolution. LLaMA-2 7B model cached at /models/Llama-2-7b-hf. C4 validation data downloaded to /autosota_cache/hf/datasets_local/ due to datasets library HF mirror 308 redirect issue. ANS compression (nvCOMP) not required for perplexity evaluation since compression is lossless; evaluation uses compress=False.

optimization_objective.summary: Minimize C4 Perplexity for LLaMA-2 7B under EntQuant compression at a target bit rate (3-bit: reg_param=14.5). Lower perplexity indicates better compression-quality trade-off.

metrics.name: c4_perplexity
metrics.rationale: C4 perplexity is the primary compression-quality benchmark for data-free LLM quantization, as reported in Table 3 of the paper. Lower values indicate better language modeling quality after compression.

optimization_objective.success_policy: Lower C4 perplexity indicates a better compression-quality trade-off. Any improvement over the baseline 7.5491 is a win. The metric direction is lower_better, so target values below 7.5491.
